en.t: How painful life in this world is!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了，心中想道：“命妇这首诗也并不特别优秀。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this, he thought to himself, "This poem of Myobu's is not especially fine either.

units.source_text: 但那位小姐倘有这点才能，也就好了。

en.t: But if that young lady had even this much talent, that would be good enough.
The more I think about it, the sorrier I feel for her.

units.source_text: 但她毕竟是身份高贵的人，我替她散播恶名，也太忍心了。”

en.t: But after all, she is a woman of noble rank, and it would be too heartless of me to spread ill rumors about her."

units.source_text: 此时众侍女即将进来伺候，公子便对命妇说：“收起来吧，这种事情，教人看见了当作笑柄。”

en.t: Just then the serving women were about to come in to attend him, so the prince said to Myobu, "Put it away. If people see this sort of thing, it will become a laughingstock."

units.source_text: 他脸上显出不快之色，叹一口气。

en.t: A displeased look appeared on his face, and he sighed.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇懊悔了：“我为什么把这个给他看呢？

en.t: Taifu no Myobu regretted it: "Why did I show this to him?

units.source_text: 连我也被他看作傻子了。”

en.t: Now even I must seem like a fool to him."

units.source_text: 她很不好意思，连忙告退。

en.t: She felt deeply embarrassed and hurriedly withdrew.
